name: Opoku Ware I
contribution: The 2nd Asantehene of Oyoko heritage, who ruled the Ashanti Empire.

checks.lead: Opoku Ware I was the 2nd Asantehene of Oyoko heritage, who ruled the Ashanti Empire. Between 1718 and 1722, Opoku Ware became Asantehene during a period of civil disorder after the death of the 1st Asanthene. From 1720 to 1721, Opoku established his power.
